description: This is a Java source file defining the CatalogWorker class, which contains utility methods for managing product catalogs in the OFBiz framework. It includes functions to retrieve catalog IDs, names, categories, and related information, and interacts with the database and web request/session objects.

classes.name: CatalogWorker
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods for managing and retrieving product catalog information in OFBiz.

methods.name: getWebSiteId
methods.description: Deprecated method to retrieve website ID from request, calls WebSiteWorker.getWebSiteId.

methods.name: getWebSite
methods.description: Deprecated method to retrieve website info from request, calls WebSiteWorker.getWebSite.

methods.name: getAllCatalogIds
methods.description: Returns a list of all catalog IDs by querying ProdCatalog entities, ordered by catalogName.

methods.name: getStoreCatalogs
methods.description: Returns catalogs associated with current product store.

methods.name: getPartyCatalogs
methods.description: Returns catalogs associated with the current user's party.

methods.name: getProdCatalogCategories
methods.description: Retrieves categories for a given catalog and category type.

methods.name: getCurrentCatalogId
methods.description: Determines current catalog ID from request parameter, session, or database, and sets it in session if needed.

methods.name: getCatalogIdsAvailable
methods.description: Returns available catalog IDs based on party and store catalogs.

methods.name: getCatalogName
methods.description: Fetches catalog name given catalog ID.

methods.name: getContentPathPrefix
methods.description: Returns cleaned content path prefix for current catalog.

methods.name: getTemplatePathPrefix
methods.description: Returns cleaned template path prefix for current catalog.

methods.name: getProdCatalog
methods.description: Fetches the GenericValue representing the catalog.

methods.name: getProdCatalogCategoryId
methods.description: Finds category ID for specific category type in a catalog.

methods.name: getCatalogTopCategoryId
methods.description: Returns the top (browse root) category ID for the catalog.

methods.name: getCatalogSearchCategoryId
methods.description: Returns the search category ID for the catalog.

methods.name: getCatalogViewAllowCategoryId
methods.description: Returns the view-allowed category ID.

methods.name: getCatalogPurchaseAllowCategoryId
methods.description: Returns the purchase-allowed category ID.

methods.name: getCatalogPromotionsCategoryId
methods.description: Returns the promotions category ID.

methods.name: getCatalogQuickaddUse
methods.description: Indicates whether quick add is used.

methods.name: getCatalogQuickaddCategoryPrimary
methods.description: Returns the primary category ID for quick add.

methods.name: getCatalogQuickaddCategories
methods.description: Returns the list of quick add category IDs.

methods.name: getCatalogTopEbayCategoryId
methods.description: Returns the eBay category ID for the catalog.
